pr.title: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins

raw_findings.body: `margin-left: auto` and the flex `order` property have no effect on a normal block-level child of a non-flex parent, so `.panel` loses its previous right-alignment and collapses into normal block flow, breaking the header layout (login/sign-up buttons, icons no longer pinned to the right edge).
raw_findings.failure_mode: CSS declarations that require a flex/grid item context are silently ignored, causing an unintended layout regression instead of the intended flex reflow.
raw_findings.impact: `margin-left: auto` and the flex `order` property have no effect on a normal block-level child of a non-flex parent, so `.panel` loses its previous right-alignment and collapses into normal block flow, breaking the header layout (login/sign-up buttons, icons no longer pinned to the right edge).
raw_findings.root_cause: Replaced a working `float: right;` declaration with flexbox-only properties without verifying that `.panel`'s parent is a flex container.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either restore `float: right;` on `.panel`, or make `.d-header` (its actual parent) a flex container / move `.panel` inside `.contents` so the new `margin-left: auto` and `@include order(3);` actually take effect.
raw_findings.title: `.panel`'s `order`/`margin-left:auto` are no-ops because its parent `.d-header` is not a flex container, and the working `float: right` was removed
raw_findings.trigger: Header renders with `.panel` (containing login/sign-up buttons and header icons) as a direct child of `.d-header`, which is NOT a flex container (only its sibling `.contents` got `@include flexbox();` in this same patch); the previous `float: right;` rule on `.panel` was deleted in this hunk.

raw_findings.body: Per the CSS Flexbox spec, `float` on a flex item is computed as `none`, so the action `button` no longer sticks to the far right of the row; instead it renders immediately after `.small-action-desc` in normal flex order, shifting the button's position and changing the small-action layout.
raw_findings.failure_mode: A previously effective float-based positioning rule becomes a silent no-op once the parent switches to flex display, causing an unintended visual layout shift.
raw_findings.impact: Per the CSS Flexbox spec, `float` on a flex item is computed as `none`, so the action `button` no longer sticks to the far right of the row; instead it renders immediately after `.small-action-desc` in normal flex order, shifting the button's position and changing the small-action layout.
raw_findings.root_cause: `.small-action` was converted into a flex container without updating the child `button` rule that still depends on `float: right` for positioning, a property flexbox ignores on flex items.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add `margin-left: auto;` to the `button` rule (or `justify-content: space-between;` on `.small-action`) so the button is still pushed to the far right under the new flex layout.
raw_findings.title: Converting `.small-action` to `display:flex` makes the sibling `button`'s `float: right` layout ineffective
raw_findings.trigger: Rendering a 'small action' post (e.g. moved/edited notice) whose action `button` is a direct child of `.small-action`; the unchanged `button { float: right; }` rule further down still relies on floating for right-alignment.

raw_findings.body: `-ms-align-items` was never a real property recognized by any browser (legacy IE10 used `-ms-flex-align`, already present on the prior line), so this line only adds dead/confusing CSS with no cross-browser benefit.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Generated CSS contains an inert declaration that can mislead future maintainers into believing it provides additional browser support.
raw_findings.impact: `-ms-align-items` was never a real property recognized by any browser (legacy IE10 used `-ms-flex-align`, already present on the prior line), so this line only adds dead/confusing CSS with no cross-browser benefit.
raw_findings.root_cause: Mixin author added an extra vendor-prefixed declaration that does not correspond to any actual browser implementation.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the redundant `-ms-align-items` declaration since `-ms-flex-align` already provides the legacy IE10 flexbox alignment syntax.
raw_findings.title: `-ms-align-items` is a non-existent vendor property and dead code in the new `align-items` mixin
raw_findings.trigger: Any call to `@include align-items(...)` (used in header.scss, topic-post.scss, badges.css.scss by this same patch) compiles this declaration into the output CSS.
